`umami-kotlin`: Kotlin Multiplatform Umami REST wrapper. Modules: `:umami`, `:sample:simple-compose-app`, `:sample:terminalApp`; packages `api`, `core`, `domain`. Uses Ktor, Coroutines, Serialization, `kotlin.time.Instant`, Kermit, Kotest, Mokkery, and Channel processing. `UmamiOptionsBuilder` is a Builder; `Umami` is a facade. Engines: OkHttp/Darwin.

All contributions must adhere to the guidelines outlined in [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

Gradle. Detekt: `detekt/detekt.yml`, automatic before git push. Qlty: `.qlty/qlty.toml`. Please ensure your changes do not introduce any new static analysis issues. Kover requirements: root `build.gradle.kts`.

All new features must be accompanied by tests. Bug fixes should also include a test that reproduces the bug. All new tests should use Kotest matchers (e.g., `shouldBe`) instead of `kotlin.test` assertions.
